name: library
description: Every workflow in the library, in dependency order, on one story — Maren the lighthouse keeper. Text-to-image results feed the edits, the edits and pictures feed the videos, and one text-to-video result is the source of every video-to-video card. Cards that do the same job are given the same inputs so they can be compared. Settings are each card's defaults except prompts and inputs, so the measured times are the real ones.

runs.note: THE scene of the suite: every later lighthouse picture and video starts here.

params.prompt_138:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the woman in <Picture 1>: Maren, a lighthouse keeper with short silver-grey hair and a weathered face, in a bright yellow raincoat, navy sweater, dark trousers and black boots.
<Subject 2> is the brass ship's lantern in <Picture 2>: domed top, carrying ring, glass panes around a lit candle.

summary:
[reference generation] A 5-second single shot: <Subject 1> climbs the last turn of a spiral iron staircase inside the lighthouse at night, carrying <Subject 2>, lit, and stops at the top to look out of the window at the storm.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - face, grey hair, yellow raincoat, boots.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the brass lantern with its glass panes and lit candle.

detailed_description:
Moody cinematic night interior, warm lantern light against cold blue storm light from the windows.
[Shot 1] A low angle at the foot of the last turn of the staircase: <Subject 1> climbs toward the camera holding <Subject 2> at chest height, its candlelight swinging across the curved white wall. At about three seconds she reaches the top, raises the lantern and turns her head to the rain-streaked window, where lightning flashes once over the sea.

overall_soundscape:
Boots on iron steps, the lantern handle creaking, rain and wind against the tower, one distant thunder roll.

non_diegetic_music:
A soft low cello note that swells at the window.

runs.note: The same references and prompt.
